value.rationale: The result exactly solves the natural arity-spectrum and inverse reconstruction problem for finite strict weak-order complex algebras. It classifies the entire ordered list of recoverable parameters and proves sharp invisibility of the initial level width. This is an infinite-family complete invariant and substantive structural boundary, not a numerical isolated table or simple substituted instance.
